summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by BioNTech SE disclosing interim Phase 2 data from a clinical trial (ROSETTA Lung-02) evaluating the investigational drug pumitamig plus chemotherapy in non-small cell lung cancer. This is a routine regulatory filing of clinical trial results, not a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or other corporate event. No deal terms or corporate structural changes are mentioned.
